//==
// Blends each point toward the sphere of Radius about Center. Strength in
// [0, 1]: 0 leaves the point unchanged, 1 places it on (or toward) the sphere
// along the radial ray from Center.
type Spherify3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}
